HXAL.new: Every basic attack against heroes, and every 2 basic attacks against non-heroes generate charge. Once fully charged Xal'atath can activate Void Volley to unleash a barrage of 6 Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 72 damage on impact.
HXAL.old: After attacking enemies with her Basic Attacks 5 times, Xal'atath can activate Void Volley to unleash a barrage of 6 Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 90 damage on impact.

HXAL.new: Each time the Dark Heart damages an enemy Hero, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.
Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xal'atath's original postion.
HXAL.old: Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xalatath's original postion.

HXAL.new: Detonating the Dark Heart now Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.
HXAL.old: Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.

HXAL.new: Void Convergence's Void Portal self decay is no longer lethal, raises the active Void Portal limit to 2, and can spawn and sustain up to 4 Void Minions.
HXAL.old: Void Convergence's Void Portal no longer has a life duration, raises the active Void Portal limit to 2, and can spawn and sustain up to 4 Void Minions.

HXAL.new: Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xalatath's original postion.
HXAL.old: Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xalataths original postion.

Abat.new: Reduce damage taken by Locusts from non-Heroes by 50% and increase their damage by 60%.
Abat.old: Increases Locust's Health by 100% and damage by 60%.

Mura.new: Reward: Upon hitting 45 targets, Storm Bolt pierces to hit an additional target, and Muradin's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 0.5 seconds and restore 3 Mana.
